-# Host-run usage capture (`host_run`) and the read-only usage sweep (`usage_sweep`)
-Proofbound launches host CLIs (Codex, Claude, Antigravity/agy) for reviewer and
-quorum work. `lattice host_run` is the single launcher **choke point** that runs
-those hosts and writes LLM usage-ledger rows for every run, so host-side spend is
-attributed instead of invisible. `lattice usage_sweep` is a strictly read-only
-companion that retro-attributes host transcript stores for runs that never went
-through the choke point.
-lattice-initiated host run now flows through `host_run`, which records a
-preflight estimate row and a provider-reported final row per run. Runs that
-Proofbound cannot route through the choke point (interactive desktop sessions)
-are covered after the fact by the read-only `usage_sweep`.
-lattice host_run --host <codex|claude|agy> --agentType <type> \
-  [--timeoutMs <ms>] [--agyPrintTimeout 30m] [--json]
-The host stdout streams through **live**: the default production runner is an
-async `child_process.spawn`, and host output passes through to the parent as it
-arrives (no buffering-until-exit, no `maxBuffer` truncation). A one-line usage
-summary is written to stderr, for example:
-In `--json` mode the full host transcript is delivered live on **stderr** so that
-**stdout stays clean** for the one JSON result; the JSON `stdout` field therefore
-carries only the bounded usage-parse tail, not the full transcript.
-Exactly one of `--prompt` / `--promptFile` is required. A host non-zero exit (or
-a cap refusal) propagates as a non-zero process exit; in `--json` mode the
-command never throws and `exitCode` is a field.

Proofbound CLI 0.3.5 is the CLI-first product entry point for the Proofbound Story workflow. `lattice` is the only active product command, pointing at the same set of project state, phase, gate, review, evidence, and handoff semantics.

This repository currently contains:

- `packages/main`: the Proofbound core CLI
- `packages/utils`: extension tools such as `aux_*`, `truth_*`, and `tool_status`
- `bin/lattice.js`: the full bootstrap entry point (`main + utils`); used only by this repository itself, and not generated by the default global-thin init for new projects
- `bin/lattice-codex.js`: the Codex-specific local entry point, which records activity as `source=codex`; generated only with explicit opt-in in full/thin mode, and not generated by default in global-thin

## Brief-by-default outputs (agent-loop context hygiene)

The highest-volume read-only commands print a **brief** summary by default so an
agent loop does not re-pay a multi-kilobyte dump on every subsequent model call
in the same turn. This is rendering-only: no gate, state-machine, or storage
behavior changes, and the explicit machine-JSON shape is frozen (see below).

Brief-by-default commands:

| Command | Brief default | Full output |
|---|---|---|
| `milestone_status` | phase, progress counts, one line per milestone (status + claim), next action | `--full` = the 7-column markdown table |
| post-mutation milestone suffix (appended after `story_advance` and every mutating command) | the compact milestone/checklist-derived summary | `LATTICE_BRIEF_OUTPUT=0` (or the command's own `--full`, when its schema exposes it) |
| `finding_list` | JSON skeleton: `findings[]` with `id`, `severity`, `category`, `status`, `evidenceState`, truncated `title`; `attention.suspected`/`disproven` preserved; heavy free-text (`description`, reviewer read evidence) dropped; `_brief`+`_hint` added | `--full` = every field |
| `help` | grouped command names only — every registered command listed, no per-command descriptions (with ~320 commands any in-budget description degrades into a meaningless fragment); footer pointing at `lattice <command> --help` and `lattice help --full` | `--full` = the verbose catalog (descriptions, parameter schemas, development flow) |
| `story_list` | meta fields (`_dashboard`/`_phases`/`_bugSummary`/`_testMissing`) preserved; the story array trimmed to non-terminal (actionable) stories as one-liners; per-phase counts cover ALL stories; `_brief`+`_omittedTerminal`+`_hint` added | `--full` = every story with full fields |
